name: Desktop single mode load solopreneur view
description:
**Summary**

1. The task was to make mobile and single-view mode (any route except `/…/desktop`) land on the existing Solopreneur cockpit view by default.
2. Investigation confirmed `src/views/SolopreneurView.vue`, its route `/solopreneur/:module?`, and its `config/apps.js` entry already existed — only the landing redirect was missing.
3. The fix was applied in `src/router/navigate.js → onRouteChanged`, redirecting `root` (`/`) and `home` (`/:projectName`) to `{ name: 'solopreneur', replace: true }`, while keeping the unscoped root un-redirected until a project loads.
4. Desktop mode was left untouched (`codx-junior-split` never matches `root|home`), and redirect loops are avoided because `restoreLastActiveProject` and `syncRouteProjectPrefix` already exempt `solopreneur`.
5. `src/App.vue` received a comment-only update documenting that Solopreneur is the default single/mobile screen; the sidebar is hidden there via `isFullScreenRoute`.
